# pve_acl (Resource)

ACL grant of one role on one path to users and/or groups. Declare one resource per (path, role); matching entries are looked up in the ACL list.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "pve_acl" "example" {
path = "CHANGE_ME"
roles = "CHANGE_ME"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `path` (String) Access control path
- `roles` (String) List of roles.

### Optional

- `delete` (Boolean) Remove permissions (instead of adding it).
- `groups` (String) List of groups.
- `propagate` (Boolean) Allow to propagate (inherit) permissions. (default: 1)
- `tokens` (String) List of API tokens.
- `users` (String) List of users.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) Opaque identifier: path/roles (also the `terraform import` format).
